movie.title: The Internship
movie.overview: A CIA-trained assassin recruits other graduates from her secret childhood program, The Internship, to violently destroy the organization. The CIA fights back with deadly force.

reviews.author: MovieGuys
reviews.content:
"Rather silly" is my first and lasting reaction to "The Internship". 

It tediously recycles overused concepts to craft, if that's the right word, a predictable and oftentimes absurd, action espionage thriller. It's all about a group of super spy teens trying to escape the CIA, that created them. Worse still, the evil Russians are out to exterminate them, or are they? 

The action, such as it is, is reasonably well done, if implausible, and the acting is alright but not inspired. 

In summary, a very ordinary action spy thriller you have seen many, many times before in one form or another. A basic watch.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A CIA-trained assassin unites fellow survivors of a covert childhood indoctrination program to dismantle the corrupt organization that created them before the agency can eliminate them.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Raised and molded from childhood in a top-secret CIA program known as The Internship, an elite assassin decides to turn against her former masters. Seeking vengeance and freedom, she recruits other graduates of the lethal program to wage a violent war against the agency. Realizing the existential threat posed by its own creations, the CIA responds with ruthless deadly force to neutralize the rogue operatives. As blood spills on both sides, a high-stakes struggle for survival and justice unfolds.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: In the shadow of black-budget government operations, an elite assassin emerges from 'The Internship,' a secret CIA program that systematically turns children into ruthless killers. After realizing the depths of the organization's cruelty and corruption, she breaks away from her handlers and vows to tear down the system from the inside. Knowing she cannot achieve this monumental goal alone, she tracks down and recruits fellow graduates of the program who share her trauma and thirst for revenge. United by their shared past and deadly skill set, the rogue group launches a coordinated violent campaign against CIA infrastructure and high-ranking officials. However, the agency quickly recognizes the catastrophic threat posed by its former assets and mobilizes its full, lethal arsenal to eliminate them. What follows is a brutal game of cat-and-mouse played out across global battlegrounds, where former operatives must test their training against the very institution that honed them. As the CIA deploys relentless countermeasures, the line between hunter and hunted blurs in an escalating war of attrition. Internal tensions rise within the team as collateral damage mounts and trust is pushed to its absolute limits. Ultimately, the assassin and her allies must face impossible odds to expose the agency's darkest secrets and destroy The Internship once and for all.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Internship is an explosive action drama that delves into the dark world of clandestine intelligence operations and deep-seated conditioning. The narrative follows a highly trained CIA assassin who breaks free after uncovering the horrific truth behind her origins. Molded since youth in a secret project known as 'The Internship,' she sets out to systematically dismantle the covert program that stripped away her humanity. To accomplish her mission, she reunites with other deadly graduates of the initiative, forming an unstoppable squad bent on retribution. Facing off against their former creators, the group finds themselves in the crosshairs of a ruthless CIA defense force willing to cross any line to contain the breach. Combining intense action sequences with a dramatic exploration of trauma and redemption, the story highlights what happens when lethal weapons turn against those who forged them.
